resources.name: sell-shells API
resources.description: Requests for the sell-shells Express API.

resources.name: Health check
resources.description: Check that the API server is running.

resources.name: List active shells
resources.description: Lists shell_description rows where is_deleted is not true.

resources.name: Get shell by ID
resources.description: Replace shell_id in the environment with an existing row UUID.

resources.name: Update shell description
resources.description: Updates only the supplied fields.

resources.name: Soft-delete shell description
resources.description: Sets is_deleted to true; it does not physically remove the row.

resources.name: Get table column metadata
resources.description: Requires SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY to be configured on the API server.

resources.name: Create shell description
resources.description: The database generates shell_id and created_at. After creating, copy the returned shell_id into the environment before using the get, update, or soft-delete requests.

resources.name: List shell stock types
resources.description: Paginated shell stock type collection.

resources.name: Get shell stock type
resources.description: Replace shell_stock_type_id with a returned stock_id.

resources.name: Create shell stock type
resources.description: The database generates stock_id and created_at.

resources.name: Update shell stock type
resources.description: Updates the selected shell stock type.

resources.name: Delete shell stock type
resources.description: Returns 409 when shell_stocks_info rows reference this stock type.

resources.name: List shell stocks info
resources.description: Supports shell_id and shell_stock_id filters.

resources.name: Get shell stocks info
resources.description: shell_stocks_info uses stock_info_id, a bigint identity.

resources.name: Create shell stocks info
resources.description: Foreign keys must identify existing shell_description and shell_stock_type rows. The database generates stock_info_id and created_at.

resources.name: Update shell stocks info
resources.description: Numeric columns accept finite JSON numbers or null.

resources.name: Delete shell stocks info
resources.description: Physically deletes this shell_stocks_info record.

resources.name: List shell images
resources.description: Supports shell_id and file_name filters; records with stored files include image_url and image_url_expires_at.

resources.name: Get shell image
resources.description: Replace image_id with a returned image id.

resources.name: Create shell image
resources.description: Select a local JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF image (maximum 5 MB). shell_id is optional.

resources.name: List main shell images
resources.description: Returns shell images flagged as the main image.

resources.name: Update shell image
resources.description: Updates the metadata row. This API does not upload image file contents.

resources.name: Delete shell image
resources.description: Physically deletes this shell_images metadata record.

resources.name: List shell types
resources.description: Paginated shell type collection.

resources.name: Get shell type
resources.description: Replace shell_type_id with a returned type_id.

resources.name: Create shell type
resources.description: The database generates type_id and created_at.

resources.name: Update shell type
resources.description: Updates the selected shell type.

resources.name: Delete shell type
resources.description: Returns 409 if a shell_description row references this shell type.

resources.name: Get current account
resources.description: Returns the signed-in account and its database-backed role.

resources.name: List accounts and roles
resources.description: Superadmin only. Lists all registered accounts and their current roles.

resources.name: Assign account role
resources.description: Superadmin only. Assigns a role to another account; the current account cannot change its own role.

resources.name: List shell localities
resources.description: Works with the shell_locality locality lookup table.

resources.name: Get shell locality
resources.description: Works with the shell_locality locality lookup table.

resources.name: Create shell locality
resources.description: Works with the shell_locality locality lookup table.

resources.name: Update shell locality
resources.description: Works with the shell_locality locality lookup table.

resources.name: Delete shell locality
resources.description: Returns 409 if a shell_description row references this locality.

resources.name: Shop - checkout configuration
resources.description: Read the store currency, delivery fee and PayPal readiness. No customer sign-in is required.

resources.name: Shop - create guest session
resources.description: Run once and copy data.token from the response into shop_session_token in the Base Environment. This capability token grants access to this browser-like cart and its orders; keep it private.

resources.name: Shop - shell availability
resources.description: Check live stock availability for a shell.

resources.name: Shop - get cart
resources.description: Returns the cart belonging to shop_session_token.

resources.name: Shop - add cart item
resources.description: Add quantity to the guest cart. Repeated POST requests increase the quantity.

resources.name: Shop - set item quantity
resources.description: Set the exact cart quantity for a shell.

resources.name: Shop - remove cart item
resources.description: Remove the shell from this guest cart.

resources.name: Shop - create PayPal order
resources.description: Creates a local order from server-validated prices and returns a PayPal order ID. Complete approval in the storefront PayPal button, then copy data.order_id into the environment. Do not call capture to simulate payment.

resources.name: Shop - capture approved payment
resources.description: Call only after the customer approved this PayPal order in the storefront. Backend verifies the captured amount, currency, and local order association.

resources.name: Shop - list order history
resources.description: Lists only orders owned by this guest session token.

resources.name: Shop - get invoice order
resources.description: Returns the session-owned invoice and persisted order item snapshots.
